task_description: Enforce scheduled defense prerequisite before title proposal approval / auto-complete schedule when title is approved; hide draggable card when dragging so time slot is visible; label capstone phase/title proposal on card; align milestone table grid lines; make milestone cutoff Academic Year (Batch) a dynamic dropdown sourced from instructor's created school years.

changes_made.summary: Enforced defense schedule prerequisite in approveTitle: project.defenseSchedule must be 'scheduled' with date or 'completed', throwing DEFENSE_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED AppError if pending; automatically sets defenseSchedule.status = 'completed', verdict = 'Passed', and completedAt timestamp upon title approval.
Added client-side defense schedule validation guard in handleApprove with Sonner error toast directing user to schedule the hearing in Scheduling Center.
Added defense schedule guard on proposal approval vote action with explanatory feedback.

Implemented getTransparentDragImage() with e.dataTransfer.setDragImage for 100% invisible drag ghost; implemented getTeamCapstoneLabel() with Capstone 1: Title Proposal badges; aligned Header, Milestone Ribbon, and Timeline grid columns to locked 84px column 1 and repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)) with min-w-0 on day cells; merged created academic years into allBatches.
Imported useAcademicYears hook and replaced raw text input for Academic Year (Batch) with dynamic <select> dropdown sourced from instructor's created academic years and active batch years.
Created comprehensive unit test suite asserting defense schedule prerequisite gating and auto-completion behavior upon approval.

verification.playwright_visual_audit: 6 visual audit screenshots verified across Desktop (1440x900) and Mobile (390x844) in Light and Dark modes with zero grid line misalignment and transparent drag preview
